newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says Griffin oil vessel returning.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says Griffin oil vessel returning.

text.p: The Griffin floating oil platform has started its return journey to its production site offshore of Western Australia after disconnecting on Tuesday to avoid a cyclone, Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Wednesday.
"We'll be back on site tomorrow (Thursday) morning and weather and swell permitting will reconnect as soon as possible," a BHP spokesman said.
The 86,000-barrel-a-day capacity unit disconnected at around 2.00 p.m. (0300 GMT) Tuesday and travelled 20 hours west to avoid Cyclone Ophelia, the spokesman said.
BHP holds 45 percent of Griffin and is the operator. Mobil Exploration and Producing Australia holds 35 percent and Inpex Alpha Ltd owns the remaining 20 percent.
